svg.text: Sprint lifecycle: states, checkpoints, Resume, Start fresh, Archive & Defer — src/ui.mjs (2026-11-20)
On the browser screen, sprints, research boards (.research), workbenches (.workbench) and brainstorms can be open at once (#d1, #d2…).
1. Unstarted context (/new or launch)
• No folder, transcript or checkpoint on disk yet
• Screen /new: opens beside open sprints
& brainstorms (unstarted brainstorm becomes it)
• Settings changes apply directly before 1st message
• Worker tasks before 1st message use worker/main
• Valid 1st message → openBoard():
claudeTitle() (30s) → mkdir + session-*.md
1st msg
2. Brainstorm (/brainstorm)
• Several open per folder; brainstorms/<name>/
(transcripts/, drawings/, files/ attachments)
• Checkpoint under brainstorms/<name> (no worker)
• Resume, Close, Restart, Start fresh & Delete work
• /convert → sprint or research (.research, fresh)
• No worker, auto dev or automatic summary
• Agents write only drawings (may read root & files/)
3. Open sprint (in use / open beside)
• Folder: discussions/<date-title>/
• Session log: transcripts/session-*.md
• Own agent sessions + worker session (workerSeat)
• Worktree: <repo>.workers/<name>/
(branch worker/<name>, own queue)
• Saves checkpoint after each round, /summary,
worker task, and on Quit & Restart
• /close (or Close with pending work): waits for
worker, writes closing-statement.md (pointing to
pending-instructions.md), drops sessions, closes
• Close and Merge (--no-ff) or Close and Discard
(refs/discarded/): removes worktree & branch,
closes (two-click preview; room-wide lock)
saveCheckpoint() / Close / Restart
Resume / 1st msg
4a. Resume with full checkpoint (/resume <name>, or Restart)
• Checkpoint file: ~/.local/state/agent-room/paused/<rootHash>/<nameHash>.json
• If already open in another context of this folder: goto() shows it as-is
• If in archive/ or deferred/: moved back to discussions/<name>/ first
• loadCheckpoint() validates version, root, transcript file & provider session IDs:
– Restores same CLI sessions, chat, seen map, token totals & same session-*.md file
– Reattaches live worker if still running (reattachWorker); else restores worker session
– Adds state.restored notice to each agent's next prompt ("restored from checkpoint…")
– If transcript file grew after checkpoint (logBytes): warns User with line number
– reportWork() reports any interrupted or unstarted worker tasks in chat & Worker tab
• If checkpoint or provider session is invalid/missing: kept on disk, error suggests Start fresh
(Resume never silently starts a fresh session).
4b. Start fresh (/fresh), Resume closed, or without checkpoint
• /fresh <name>: discards old CLI sessions & chat; saves latest Summary (fresh: true)
• /resume on a closed sprint clears closed flag & starts fresh (fromClosed: true)
• /resume <name> with no full checkpoint also enters this state (continued: true)
• On the User's next message (openBoard(), no new title requested):
– Creates a new transcripts/session-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM.md file (older ones stay)
– Starts fresh agent & worker CLI sessions
– briefing() embeds closing-statement.md (points to pending-instructions.md),
or falls back to pending handoff.md; appends freshSummary (marked if not agreed)
– Brainstorm /fresh: briefed from latest summary, or pointed to transcripts/
• Rulebook: keep unsent worker tasks in pending-instructions.md;
do not rename closing-statement.md or handoff.md.
/move, Archive, Defer, /rollback
5. Moving sprints: discussions/archive/<name>/ & discussions/deferred/<name>/ (moveBoard in src/boards.mjs)
Common guards (enforced before any move):
• Archive & Defer require a closed sprint (refused if open, paused or closing)
• Refused if shown here (ctx.discussion.dir === from), in a round (open.busy),
a worker is writing to it, or it holds unresolved edits (workerHold)
Defer guard (/move <name> deferred):
• Also refused if worker/<name> or worker/main has commits for <name>
not merged into main. Merging into main clears the guard.
• Make active (/move archive|deferred/<name> active, stays closed), /resume
or /fresh moves the folder back to discussions/<name>/.
Archive with rollback (/rollback <name> → /archive-rollback <name>):
1. /rollback <name> queues a worker task on worker/<name> (blocks plain Archive)
2. Worker inspects worker/<name>, main & worker/main; stops before editing if
set or dependencies are ambiguous; otherwise merges main, reverts [<name>]
implementation commits newest-first, runs npm test, commits with rollback trailers
3. Harness checks clean tree, HEAD & trailer from Rollback ready: <sha>
4. User reviews report, switches away, and runs /archive-rollback <name>
(re-verifies HEAD before moving folder to discussions/archive/).
User keeps the final merge of worker/<name> into main.
Harness-enforced state & guards (src/ui.mjs)
Active sprint state
Amber = Agent convention from rulebook (asked, not enforced)
